rules: One new image-generation call per logical asset, no composite sprite sheets, no recolors of another style.
Save exact prompts under asset-prompts/<style> and original output PNGs unchanged under dist/assets/<style>.
Peanut: anthropomorphic peanut, propeller cap, white gloves and shoes.
HutchMF: human, extremely heavyset with large belly, backwards black cap, beard, black polo, jeans, tattoo arms.
Ninja: slender human, spiky blue hair, yellow headband, blue hoodie.
Use consistent perspective, lighting, palette, silhouette and outline weights within each pack.
All menu states receive their own illustration: paused, won, lost, roundWon. Character select uses the three individual character images.
UI buttons, borders, indicators and accessibility labels are code-native controls themed with each pack, not images of text.
Animation uses runtime bob, lean, squash, pulse and falling transforms of the separate assets. Direction is mirrored. No baked-in animation sheet.
Assets load atomically; never mix styles or silently substitute old assets. Disable Play during load and show a retryable error.
Original images are preserved. Runtime alpha-bounds cropping only removes transparent padding for consistent display.
Validate unique hashes and complete inventory, inspect each style in character selection, gameplay and menus at desktop and mobile sizes.

overtime.placement: Random empty floor cells, no duplicate pending drops or existing bombs; warning ring before landing; normal blast collision and chain reaction rules; bots see danger; reset every round.
